Datavault Shares Crash as Bitcoin Treasury Remains Trapped on Biconomy Amid 4-Month Withdrawal Delay Casa co-founder Jameson Lopp highlighted that Bitcoin treasury company Datavault (DVLT) saw its stock price crash, tumbling 49.55% over a 24-hour period. The plunge follows the company’s notice to investors disclosing that its entire treasury reserves are held on crypto exchange Biconomy, but despite submitting transfer and withdrawal requests for four months, it has been unable to withdraw any BTC from the platform. — link

South Korea’s Second-Largest Crypto Exchange Bithumb Confirms Security Breach According to Yonhap News Agency, South Korea’s second-largest cryptocurrency exchange, Bithumb, confirmed that an unauthorized external party accessed its internal mobile groupware system, resulting in a personal data leak. The exchange discovered the incident on October 27 and is investigating whether customer information was compromised. Two other South Korean financial institutions, Mirae Asset Global Investments and Daishin Securities, were also confirmed to have suffered cyber intrusions. Daishin Securities disclosed that the personal and credit information of 38,490 customers had been leaked. South Korea’s Financial Supervisory Service (FSS) is investigating the incidents. — link

Highlight Clip: CZ: Today Is the Best Day in History to Start a Business CZ: Today Is the Best Day in History to Start a Business On October 24, 2026, Binance founder CZ said in an interview with PIVOT that today is a better time to start a business than any previous day in history, with clear opportunities in AI, blockchain and the internet. He encouraged young people to learn new technologies, identify something others need that they enjoy and can build, and get started. He advised against the traditional path of lifetime employment at one company, encouraging more people to consider entrepreneurship while acknowledging its uncertainty and pain, alongside the potential for positive impact and financial rewards. — link

Highlight Clip: A 19th Birthday Party That Brought Together the Founders of Three Star Tech Companies A 19th Birthday Party That Brought Together the Founders of Three Star Tech Companies On October 11, Meta Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang recalled that more than a dozen guests at his 19th birthday party were mostly from Harvard University and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. Years later, Jeff Yan founded Hyperliquid, Scott Wu founded Cognition, and Jesse Zhang founded Decagon. Looking back, these young people, who once competed together, have demonstrated remarkable creativity. Wang also discussed a core principle of innovation investing: giving exceptional talent enough time, space, and resources can lead to breakthroughs that deliver returns far beyond expectations. — link
